Ahri.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ahri deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first and fit Banshee's Veil between core items. However, magic resistance does not reduce the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception on its return.
Ahri.fight: Avoid ranged poke trades early, and trade when Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost are both available. When Ahri E Charm is down and Ahri R Spirit Rush is unavailable, close the gap with Lissandra E Glacial Path and root her.
Ahri.combo: Cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward, then recast it to travel to its location. Root Ahri with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then use Lissandra Q Ice Shard and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb in order. If Ahri E Charm is available, make sure it can't immobilize you and cancel your recast.
Ahri.escape: The moment Ahri E Charm goes down is your chance to engage. Even if Ahri R Spirit Rush is unavailable, account for the movement speed from Ahri W Fox-Fire.
Ahri.laning: Dodge Ahri E Charm from behind minions while using Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves. If Ahri stands behind minions, hit a minion first and look for an angle where the shatter from Lissandra Q Ice Shard reaches her. Using Lissandra E Glacial Path for poke leaves you vulnerable to ganks.
Ahri.phase: Early on, Lissandra is at a disadvantage in ranged poke trades because of her short range, so use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to keep pace in levels. In the late game, focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing pure damage.
Ahri.teamfight: Decide first whether to engage or counter-engage. If you engage after Ahri E Charm goes down, close in with Lissandra E Glacial Path, root her with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then follow with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If you plan to counter-engage, save Lissandra R Frozen Tomb for an enemy who dives in; when you're in danger, cast it on yourself to use its damage immunity and healing.
Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits you, you can take her entire follow-up combo, so dodge it in lane by keeping minions between you and her. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit on its return too, so after dodging the first pass, move out of its return path. Magic resistance does not reduce the return's true damage.

Akshan.teamfight: Decide in advance whether to engage or counter-engage. When counter-engaging, stop the enemy who dives in with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. To engage, go in with Lissandra E Glacial Path, root multiple enemies with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then follow with your ultimate. If you have the Scoundrel mark, don't face Akshan alone; fight outside his execute range.
Akshan.build: Akshan's main damage is physical, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to withstand the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Akshan.combo: When Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward and recast it to travel to its location. Root Akshan with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then follow with Lissandra Q Ice Shard and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, in that order.
Akshan.escape: The moment Akshan E Heroic Swing goes down is Lissandra's window to engage. Close the distance with Lissandra E Glacial Path, then prevent Akshan from escaping with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Akshan.fight: Lissandra is at a disadvantage in ranged poke trades, so trade when Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost are both available.
Akshan.laning: Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping pace in levels. Akshan Q Avengerang gains range when it hits minions, so don't try to avoid poke by standing behind the wave. Save Lissandra W Ring of Frost for a sure engage or jungle follow-up, and roam after pushing the wave when W and your ultimate are available.
Akshan.phase: In the late game, focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits an enemy, so don't assume you're safe behind minions; dodge its full out-and-back path. When you're low on health and Akshan R Comeuppance marks you, move behind terrain instead of fleeing alone in the open.

AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health, and staying on the same target for a long time deals extra damage and builds stardust, so stand behind minions and quickly move out of its aim line. When low on health, avoid Aurelion Sol E Singularity's execute range; if caught, move out immediately. In the late game, spread out from your allies to avoid the knock-up and area shockwave from the empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Decide in advance whether to engage or counter-engage. To engage, use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost to root multiple enemies, then follow with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. When countering an enemy who comes in with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, interrupt them with the stun from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. Spread out from your allies before engaging so you're not all knocked up by the empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.build: Early on, use Null-Magic Mantle to withstand his damage and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Aurelion Sol's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first and fit Banshee's Veil between core items. Since Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health, don't rely on choices that only greatly increase your health.
AurelionSol.combo: After Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward, then recast it to teleport to its location. Root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then follow with Lissandra Q Ice Shard and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, in that order.
AurelionSol.escape: The moment Aurelion Sol uses W Astral Flight is your window to engage. If Aurelion Sol E Singularity or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend still has crowd control available, be careful not to have it immobilize you before you recast Lissandra E Glacial Path and cancel the teleport.
AurelionSol.fight: Rather than trading ranged poke, trade when both Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost are available. If Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, close the gap with Lissandra E Glacial Path and catch him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
AurelionSol.laning: Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping pace in levels. Stand behind minions or move out of range so you don't take Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light needlessly and give him stardust. Don't use Lissandra E Glacial Path for poke, and don't waste Lissandra W Ring of Frost on clearing waves.
AurelionSol.phase: Early on, pressure Aurelion Sol while he has little stardust to slow his scaling. In the late game, his permanent scaling puts you at a disadvantage, so Lissandra should focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage.

Galio.teamfight: While Galio R Hero's Entrance is ready, don’t start small skirmishes against Galio’s team on other lanes either. In teamfights, decide in advance whether to bind several enemies with Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then chain into Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, or save Lissandra R Frozen Tomb to interrupt Galio’s engage. When you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance, move out of its area. If you plan to counter-engage, save Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Galio.build: Galio’s damage is mostly magic, so use a Null-Magic Mantle early and prioritize magic resistance. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Fit Banshee's Veil between core items so it can block one enemy ability before you engage.
Galio.combo: To engage, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward, then recast it to teleport to the claw. Root Galio with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then chain Lissandra Q Ice Shard and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb in that order. If Galio still has crowd control available, don’t delay recasting Lissandra E Glacial Path; this prevents crowd control from stopping the teleport.
Galio.escape: Don’t engage just because Galio E Justice Punch is down; check whether Galio R Hero's Entrance is also available. In particular, use Lissandra E Glacial Path to close the gap during the window when Galio W Shield of Durand’s taunt is down, before Galio R Hero's Entrance comes back. Once you’re on him, use Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb to keep Galio from escaping.
Galio.fight: Early on, use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to poke and secure last hits. Trade only when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together. While Galio W Shield of Durand is charging, don’t commit your damage; get out of taunt range.
Galio.laning: Make Galio use his abilities to clear the wave, then, when his mana is low, push the lane with Lissandra Q Ice Shard to limit his room to roam. If Galio stands behind minions, hit a minion with Lissandra Q Ice Shard first so the shard reaches him behind it. Save Lissandra E Glacial Path instead of using it to poke, since doing so leaves you vulnerable to ganks.
Galio.phase: Early on, avoid forced poke trades because Lissandra has short range, and keep up in levels with Lissandra Q Ice Shard. In the late game, focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control over dealing raw damage.
Galio.watch: Galio Q Winds of War deals max-health-based damage over time where the two gusts overlap, so avoid that area. Charging Galio W Shield of Durand reduces the damage he takes and lengthens the taunt, so don’t commit your damage; move out of its range. Watch for the backward windup of Galio E Justice Punch and dodge it. When you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance, immediately move out of its area.

Vladimir.teamfight: Spread out so multiple allies don't get hit by Vladimir R Hemoplague, and if you are infected, back away until the effect ends. If you choose to engage, wait until Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down, then go in with Lissandra E Glacial Path and follow with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If you choose to counter their approach, save Lissandra R Frozen Tomb and stun him as he comes in.
Vladimir.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vladimir deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first and fit Banshee's Veil between core items to help you engage. If a long duel makes his healing a problem, build Grievous Wounds after your resistances.
Vladimir.combo: Bait out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first. As it ends, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path to advance. Recast E to teleport, then root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, and follow up with Lissandra Q Ice Shard and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Vladimir.escape: The window to engage is after Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down. When the pool ends, close the gap with Lissandra E Glacial Path and catch him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. Vladimir also slows while charging E Tides of Blood, which can create an opportunity to approach.
Vladimir.fight: Bait out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first, then catch him as it ends. The moment he slows himself by charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood is also a chance to close the gap.
Vladimir.laning: Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping up in levels. If Vladimir stands behind minions, hit a minion first and aim for the shard to reach him behind it. Look for an advantage early through lane pressure and ganks, and avoid using Lissandra E Glacial Path to poke first and leaving yourself vulnerable to a gank.
Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion can heal him and become empowered, so avoid forcing trades when his empowered Q is ready. When Vladimir charges E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or move out of range. If you are infected by Vladimir R Hemoplague, you take increased damage, so step back and re-engage after the effect ends.
Vladimir.phase: As Vladimir scales, he becomes a threat in the late game, so Lissandra should focus on stopping engages and crowd control over raw damage.

Aurora.teamfight: First decide whether to engage or counter Aurora's engage, and choose a target for Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. To engage, use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost to root multiple enemies, then follow with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. To counter-engage, stop Aurora as she comes in with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. Aurora's dash spell cooldown resets when she participates in a takedown, so don't leave low-health allies behind when retreating.
Aurora.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Aurora deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Since the opponent's damage is mostly magic, fit Banshee's Veil between core items.
Aurora.combo: Cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward, then recast it to travel to its location. Root Aurora with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then use Lissandra Q Ice Shard and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb in that order. While Aurora is stealthed with W Across the Veil, don't rush to use targeted abilities; look for the moment she reappears.
Aurora.escape: If only one of Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding is down, she can escape with the other mobility spell, so don't rush your engage. In particular, before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back up, engage with Lissandra E Glacial Path when she uses another mobility spell, then catch her with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Aurora.fight: Avoid ranged poke trades early, and trade when Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost are both available. If Aurora has used only one mobility spell, check for her remaining mobility, and especially look for an opening before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back up. Close the gap with Lissandra E Glacial Path, root her with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then follow with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Aurora.laning: Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping pace in levels. If Aurora is behind minions, aim to hit a minion first so the shard reaches her behind it. Using Lissandra E Glacial Path for poke leaves you vulnerable to ganks, so save it for engaging or escaping. When you push the wave and roam, check that Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb are available.
Aurora.phase: Early on, Lissandra is at a disadvantage in ranged poke trades because of her short range, so use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to keep pace in levels. In the late game, focus on crowd control to stop Aurora's engage rather than dealing pure damage.
Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, it deals damage again when recalled, and that damage increases the more health you've lost. If cursed, move out of the line between Aurora and yourself, and if you're below half health, retreat before the recall. When Aurora disappears with W Across the Veil, don't rush to use targeted abilities; wait for her to reappear. Decide whether to retreat or fight inside Aurora R Between Worlds before it unfolds.

Hwei.teamfight: Before a team fight, decide whether to go in with Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost or counter the enemy's engage with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, go in and chain Lissandra W Ring of Frost into Lissandra R Frozen Tomb; if it's ready, don't lead the engage. When you need to withstand Hwei's finishing damage, cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on yourself to avoid the damage and heal.
Hwei.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Hwei's damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first and fit Banshee's Veil between core items. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on maximum health, so don't rely on building health alone.
Hwei.combo: When Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward and recast it to move to its location. Root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then use Lissandra Q Ice Shard followed by Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility, so the moment Hwei E Subject: Torment is down is your chance to go in with Lissandra E Glacial Path. If that spell is ready, you could be immobilized before recasting Lissandra E Glacial Path and your engage could fail, so wait to go in. Conversely, when you need to use Lissandra E Glacial Path to escape, recast it before you get immobilized.
Hwei.fight: Avoid trading ranged poke early; trade when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together. Right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or wave clear, close the gap with Lissandra E Glacial Path. Once close, root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and follow with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Hwei.laning: Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping up in levels. If Hwei stands behind minions, aim to hit a minion first so the shard reaches him behind it. Don't use Lissandra E Glacial Path for poke first, and when roaming after pushing the wave, check that Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb are available.
Hwei.phase: Early on, Lissandra has short range and is at a disadvantage in ranged poke trades, so clear the wave and keep up in levels. In the late game, focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than raw damage.
Hwei.watch: Hwei E Subject: Torment can stop Lissandra's engage with a root or forced movement, so don't go in first while it's ready. If you're hit by Hwei's first spell, reposition immediately to avoid the follow-up spell and the combo with Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Don't stay on the spot marked for the ground damage from Hwei Q Subject: Disaster.

Yone.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave's shield doesn't grow, and make sure you aren't alone at the very back of the formation in preparation for Yone R Fate Sealed. If you choose to wait for Yone to engage, save Lissandra R Frozen Tomb to stop him as he comes in. If you choose to engage first, root multiple enemies with Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then follow up with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Yone.build: Get Zhonya's Hourglass early to prepare for Yone's engage. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so build both resistances instead of leaning into just one.
Yone.combo: When engaging, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path to advance, then recast it to move. Press Lissandra W Ring of Frost as soon as you arrive to root him. Follow with Lissandra Q Ice Shard, then Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Yone.escape: Don't engage recklessly when only one of Yone's mobility abilities is down, since he can escape with the one he has left. In particular, before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up, wait for Yone's other mobility ability and crowd control to be down, then close the gap with Lissandra E Glacial Path and follow with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Yone.fight: Trade when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together. If Yone comes in while in spirit form, use the Lissandra W Ring of Frost you saved to root him, prevent his return, and interrupt Yone's whirlwind Q.
Yone.laning: Keep your distance when Yone's whirlwind Q is ready, and use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves. Don't waste Lissandra W Ring of Frost on wave clear.
Yone.phase: In the late game, focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, his whirlwind is being prepared, so stay out of range until the stacks expire. After Yone E Soul Unbound engages, he can deal extra damage when returning, so if you are low, cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on yourself or move out of range beforehand.

TwistedFate.laning: Secure last hits and clear the wave with Lissandra Q Ice Shard while keeping pace in levels. Take Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from behind minions, and against an opponent using minions as a shield, aim Lissandra Q Ice Shard at a minion first so it reaches them behind it. Don’t use Lissandra E Glacial Path for poke; after pushing the wave, check that Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb are ready before roaming.
TwistedFate.build: Use Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Twisted Fate deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Fit Banshee’s Veil between your core items to block one targeted enemy ability before you engage.
TwistedFate.combo: Cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward, then recast it to blink to its location. Root Twisted Fate with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then chain Lissandra Q Ice Shard into Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is ready, a stun could cancel your blink, so don’t delay the recast.
TwistedFate.escape: Right after Twisted Fate uses the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, close in with Lissandra E Glacial Path and root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
TwistedFate.fight: Avoid ranged poke trades early and trade only when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together. If Twisted Fate has just used the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, close the distance with Lissandra E Glacial Path.
TwistedFate.phase: Lissandra is at a disadvantage in ranged poke trades early because of her short range, so survive while keeping pace in levels with Lissandra Q Ice Shard. In the late game, focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage.
TwistedFate.teamfight: To engage, root multiple enemies with Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then chain into Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If you decide to counter an engage, save Lissandra R Frozen Tomb to stop the opponent as they go in. If you see Twisted Fate R Destiny being cast within range, stop the teleport with Lissandra W Ring of Frost or Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, his next basic attack will stun you, so stay out of his attack range. Stand behind minions to reduce damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.

Azir.teamfight: Enter from multiple directions in open areas so Azir R Emperor's Divide doesn't knock back several of you together. If you decide to engage, close in with Lissandra E Glacial Path, root enemies with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then follow with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If there's no good angle to engage, save Lissandra R Frozen Tomb to stop the enemy from engaging.
Azir.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Azir's damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first and fit Banshee's Veil between core items.
Azir.combo: Cast Lissandra E Glacial Path toward Azir and recast it to arrive, then root him immediately with Lissandra W Ring of Frost. Follow with Lissandra Q Ice Shard and stun him with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. Go in this way after Azir E Shifting Sands is down to leave him less room to escape.
Azir.escape: The moment after Azir E Shifting Sands is down is your window to close the gap with Lissandra E Glacial Path. It's also a good time to approach when Azir Q Conquering Sands is down and his soldiers are stationary. If Azir R Emperor's Divide is ready, avoid entering narrow corridors; when you do go in, recast Lissandra E Glacial Path without delay.
Azir.fight: Take short trades when the soldiers are stationary and Azir Q Conquering Sands is down. If Azir has just used Azir E Shifting Sands, stick to him with Lissandra E Glacial Path, then catch him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. Don't use Lissandra E Glacial Path for poke and then commit to a long fight.
Azir.laning: Don't force your way forward against ranged poke. Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping up in levels. Against Azir standing behind minions, aim to hit a minion first so the shard reaches him behind it.
Azir.phase: Azir gets stronger as the game goes on, so in the late game Lissandra should focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Azir.watch: Stay out of the straight line of soldiers summoned by Azir W Arise!, and after Azir Q Conquering Sands moves them, circle back beside them to approach before they move again. In narrow corridors, Azir R Emperor's Divide can knock back everyone entering at once, so don't group up when going in there.

Naafiri.teamfight: Decide first whether to engage or counter Naafiri’s engage. If she goes in, stop her with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If you engage, approach with Lissandra E Glacial Path, root multiple enemies with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then chain into R. Don’t walk alone while Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is available, and fall back after an ally is killed so you aren’t picked off in succession.
Naafiri.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Naafiri deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first. Since she is an engage assassin, rush Zhonya’s Hourglass to gain both ability power and armor.
Naafiri.combo: If Naafiri’s mobility is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward, then recast it to blink to its location. Root her with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then chain Lissandra Q Ice Shard into Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, hold Lissandra R Frozen Tomb until she can be targeted.
Naafiri.escape: Don’t engage just because one of Naafiri’s mobility abilities is down; check whether she can still use Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate. In particular, close the distance with Lissandra E Glacial Path during a window when her other mobility is down, before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back. Once close, block her escape with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Naafiri.fight: Lissandra W Ring of Frost has short range and a long cooldown at low ranks, so trade only when you can use it with Lissandra E Glacial Path. If Naafiri E Eviscerate has brought her pack back, clear the pack with an area-of-effect ability and engage after Naafiri’s mobility is down. If Naafiri engages first, stop her with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Naafiri.laning: Farm and poke with Lissandra Q Ice Shard from behind your minion wave while keeping pace in levels. Try to hit a minion first so the shard reaches Naafiri behind it. Don’t use Lissandra E Glacial Path for poke; when pushing the wave to roam, make sure Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb are ready.
Naafiri.phase: In the mid game, ward widely to watch for Naafiri roams. In the late game, group with your team and focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control.
Naafiri.watch: If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you once and applies a bleed, back away until the bleed ends so you don’t get hit by the second Q. Naafiri E Eviscerate brings her pack back, so watch for damage from both the pack and Naafiri entering together. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, she can’t be targeted, so hold Lissandra R Frozen Tomb until it ends.

Zoe.watch: If you are hit by Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, move behind a wall or an ally before the sleep triggers to get out of the angle and range of Zoe Q Paddle Star! Be careful around narrow paths without vision and brush entrances, because a bubble that misses remains as a trap. If you are close when Zoe throws Zoe Q Paddle Star! and tries to redirect it, interrupt her with Lissandra W Ring of Frost or Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Zoe.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Zoe's magic damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Then fit Banshee's Veil between core items to help you engage. Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble reduces magic resistance and also deals true damage, so dodging the bubble itself comes first even if you build resistance.
Zoe.combo: When Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path to advance, then recast it to teleport to the claw. Root her with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then follow with Lissandra Q Ice Shard and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Zoe.escape: The window to engage with Lissandra E Glacial Path is right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down. If Zoe's crowd control is ready, don't delay the recast after casting Lissandra E Glacial Path.
Zoe.fight: You are at a disadvantage in ranged poke trades, so only trade when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together. Close the gap with Lissandra E Glacial Path right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down. If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, aim for the spot where she must return.
Zoe.laning: Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping up in levels. If Zoe stands behind minions, hit a minion first and aim for the shard to reach her behind it. Don't use Lissandra E Glacial Path to poke first. After pushing the wave, check that Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb are ready before roaming.
Zoe.phase: Early on, Lissandra is at a disadvantage trading ranged poke with Zoe, so use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to survive and keep up in levels. In the late game, focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing raw damage.
Zoe.teamfight: When Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, close in with Lissandra E Glacial Path and root her with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, aim for the spot where she must return to counterattack. Before starting an objective, use a Control Ward to light up the area and check for bubble traps, and decide in advance whether to engage or counter the enemy's engage with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.

Qiyana.watch: If Qiyana has the river element on Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, move out of range because its root is dangerous. If she disappears with the brush element, move into your team’s vision. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes when it hits terrain, so don’t stand with your back to a wall and avoid river areas and narrow paths.
Qiyana.build: Qiyana’s main damage is physical, so use Cloth Armor to survive and build armor first. Choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots and rush Zhonya’s Hourglass against this engage assassin.
Qiyana.combo: While Qiyana E Audacity is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward, then recast it to blink to its location. Root her with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then chain Lissandra Q Ice Shard into Lissandra R Frozen Tomb cast on the enemy.
Qiyana.escape: If only Qiyana W Terrashape is down, wait to engage because she can escape with Qiyana E Audacity.
Qiyana.fight: Trade while Qiyana is still nearby after using Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity. In particular, close the distance with Lissandra E Glacial Path before Qiyana E Audacity comes back, then root her with Lissandra W Ring of Frost.
Qiyana.laning: Secure last hits and clear the wave with Lissandra Q Ice Shard while keeping pace in levels. If Qiyana stands behind her minions, aim Lissandra Q Ice Shard at a minion so the shard reaches her behind it. Save Lissandra W Ring of Frost for an engage or reliable jungle follow-up, and don’t use Lissandra E Glacial Path for poke.
Qiyana.phase: In the early game, manage the lane with Lissandra Q Ice Shard while building armor. In the late game, stay grouped but keep away from terrain to limit Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent angles, and focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control.
Qiyana.teamfight: Before a teamfight, decide whether to engage with Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost or counter Qiyana’s engage with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If countering, cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on the enemy as Qiyana goes in to stun her and slow nearby enemies. Even when moving with your team, stay away from walls to avoid angles where Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent can detonate on terrain.

Syndra.escape: Syndra has no mobility, so the moment after she uses Syndra E Scatter the Weak is an opportunity to engage. If Syndra E Scatter the Weak is ready, watch out for a stun along the line of her spheres and don’t delay recasting Lissandra E Glacial Path. Save Lissandra E Glacial Path until you engage instead of using it for poke, so you keep your escape available.
Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere is between you and Syndra, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can knock you back and stun you, so move out of the sphere’s line. Syndra W Force of Will deals true damage, so magic resistance alone won’t protect you. When low on health, watch out for the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power; if you have to take it, cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on yourself to avoid the damage.
Syndra.build: Use Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Syndra’s magic damage and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Build magic resistance first against Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak. Fit Banshee’s Veil between your core items to block one targeted enemy ability before you engage.
Syndra.combo: After Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward, then recast it to blink to its location. Root Syndra with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then chain Lissandra Q Ice Shard into Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Syndra.fight: Avoid ranged poke trades early and trade when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together. When Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, close the distance with Lissandra E Glacial Path and root her with Lissandra W Ring of Frost.
Syndra.laning: Secure last hits and clear the wave with Lissandra Q Ice Shard while keeping pace in levels. Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak are ground-targeted or thrown abilities, so get boots early and move to dodge them. After pushing the wave, roam over terrain with Lissandra E Glacial Path while Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb are ready.
Syndra.phase: Lissandra is at a disadvantage in ranged poke trades early because of her short range, so survive while keeping pace in levels. In the late game, focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Syndra.teamfight: Decide whether to engage first or counter the opponent’s engage. If engaging, root multiple enemies with Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then chain into Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. Areas with multiple Syndra Q Dark Sphere spheres are dangerous because of Syndra R Unleashed Power, so move away or go in prepared to take her ultimate. If countering, save Lissandra R Frozen Tomb to stop the opponent’s engage.

Zed.phase: Build armor early so Zed doesn't gain an advantage, and use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to keep up in levels. The mid game is a strong point for both Zed and Lissandra, so use Lissandra's roots and stuns when Zed's mobility is down. In the late game, group with your allies so Zed has fewer isolated targets, and focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing raw damage.
Zed.build: Zed's main damage is physical, and Lissandra has relatively low armor, so build armor early with Cloth Armor. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots, and get Zhonya's Hourglass early against the diving assassin Zed. Lissandra's magic damage is effective against Zed, who has relatively low magic resistance.
Zed.combo: When Zed's mobility is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path to close the gap, then recast it to teleport to the claw. Root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then follow with Lissandra Q Ice Shard and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If you are countering Zed as he comes in with Zed R Death Mark, interrupt his combo while the mark is active with Lissandra W Ring of Frost or Lissandra R Frozen Tomb cast on the enemy.
Zed.escape: Look for an opportunity just after Zed uses Zed W Living Shadow, but only engage once the shadow has disappeared or Zed has already changed position. If you go in when only Zed W Living Shadow is down, he can escape with Zed R Death Mark, so look especially for an opening before Zed R Death Mark comes back up. Then approach with Lissandra E Glacial Path and root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Zed.fight: Early on, only trade when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together. Look for an opening after Zed uses Zed W Living Shadow, once the shadow has disappeared or Zed has already changed position, but check whether Zed R Death Mark is still available.
Zed.laning: Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping up in levels. If Zed stands behind minions, hit a minion with Lissandra Q Ice Shard first and aim for the shard to reach him behind it. Don't waste Lissandra W Ring of Frost on wave clear or use Lissandra E Glacial Path to poke first and leave yourself vulnerable to a gank.
Zed.teamfight: Before a teamfight, decide whether to engage and root multiple enemies with Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost, or counter Zed's engage with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If Zed comes in with Zed R Death Mark, prevent him from building up damage while the mark is active with Lissandra W Ring of Frost or Lissandra R Frozen Tomb cast on the enemy. If you need to take the mark's detonation damage, you can also cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on yourself as it detonates.
Zed.watch: Zed Q Razor Shuriken deals area damage, and the slow from Zed E Shadow Slash only comes from his shadow, so watch the shadow's position and move out of range. If Zed R Death Mark marks you, lock him down with Lissandra W Ring of Frost or Lissandra R Frozen Tomb before he builds up damage. When the mark detonates, you can cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on yourself to avoid the damage with immunity.

Anivia.teamfight: Anivia W Crystallize can block narrow paths, so fight in the wider part of the lane if possible, and save Flash in case you get separated from your allies. To engage, go in with Lissandra E Glacial Path, root multiple enemies with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then follow with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If there's no opening to engage, save R to stop an enemy engage.
Anivia.build: Early on, use Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Anivia's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and fit Banshee's Veil between core items to boost your magic resistance.
Anivia.combo: Cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward, recast it to teleport, then root Anivia with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive. Follow with Lissandra Q Ice Shard and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If Anivia is behind minions, aim so Q hits a minion first and passes through to reach her behind it.
Anivia.escape: Engage with Lissandra E Glacial Path during the window after Anivia Q Flash Frost goes down. If Anivia's crowd control is still available, don't delay the recast; otherwise it may immobilize you before you recast E and cancel the teleport.
Anivia.fight: Trade when Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost are both available. If Anivia Q Flash Frost is down, close the gap with E and root her with W and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If Anivia P Rebirth is available, engage with your jungler or another ally so you can reliably destroy the egg.
Anivia.laning: Rather than trading against her long-range poke, use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping pace in levels. Using Lissandra E Glacial Path for poke leaves you vulnerable to ganks, so save it for engaging or escaping. When you push the wave and roam, check that Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb are available.
Anivia.phase: In the late game, focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing pure damage, and watch out for Anivia's terrain control.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost explodes at the spot where it is recast and stuns, so don't just sidestep the projectile; dodge the explosion location too. If you've been hit by Q or are inside a fully grown Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage, so use Lissandra E Glacial Path to get out of the storm and avoid the next Frostbite.

Corki.teamfight: When engaging, go in with Lissandra E Glacial Path, root multiple enemies with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then follow with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If there's no good angle to engage, save Lissandra R Frozen Tomb to stop the enemy from engaging. If you're focused, you can cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on yourself to avoid damage and heal.
Corki.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first to counter Corki's main damage. Corki P Hextech Munitions deals true damage that resistances can't block, so also consider your total health.
Corki.combo: After Corki W Valkyrie is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward and recast it to teleport to its location. Root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then use Lissandra Q Ice Shard followed by Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Corki.fight: Trade early only when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together. When Corki W Valkyrie is down, close the gap with Lissandra E Glacial Path and root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost.
Corki.laning: Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping up in levels. Against Corki behind minions, aim Lissandra Q Ice Shard at a minion first so the shard reaches him behind it. Save Lissandra E Glacial Path; using it for poke first leaves you vulnerable to ganks.
Corki.phase: Corki has low base stats during the first five levels, so pressure his lane and use ganks to disrupt his farming. In the late game, slow his growth before he can build items and fire missiles from a safe position; Lissandra should focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control.
Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages targets around the first one hit, so don't hide behind minions; get out of range. Reposition so you aren't hit repeatedly, especially by the third missile. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces your armor and magic resistance, so don't stand and take it head-on; move to the side.
Corki.escape: If Corki W Valkyrie is available, diving onto him recklessly lets him escape over terrain. After Corki W Valkyrie is used, go in with Lissandra E Glacial Path and lock him down with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.

Ryze.teamfight: To engage, close in with Lissandra E Glacial Path, root multiple enemies with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then chain into Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If countering an engage, save Lissandra R Frozen Tomb to stop the opponent as they go in, and block Ryze himself when you see Ryze R Realm Warp. When in danger, you can cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on yourself to avoid damage and heal, but account for being unable to act during stasis.
Ryze.build: Ryze’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early, choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots, and fit Banshee’s Veil between your core items to prepare for an engage.
Ryze.combo: Cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward, then recast it to blink to its location. Root Ryze with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then use Lissandra Q Ice Shard followed by Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Ryze.escape: If you dodge Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze W Rune Prison only slows, giving you a chance to close the distance with Lissandra E Glacial Path. If Ryze W Rune Prison can root you, don’t delay recasting Lissandra E Glacial Path.
Ryze.fight: Instead of trading ranged poke, trade when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together.
Ryze.laning: Ryze lacks mana and damage early, so pressure him before he finishes his items, while securing last hits and clearing the wave with Lissandra Q Ice Shard to keep pace in levels. If Ryze stands behind his minions, hit a minion first so the shard reaches him behind it. Don’t use Lissandra E Glacial Path for poke; after pushing the wave, roam while Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb are ready.
Ryze.watch: When marked by Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze Q Overload is empowered and Ryze W Rune Prison becomes a root. If hit by Ryze E Spell Flux, move away from your allies and keep your distance until the mark disappears. If you see Ryze R Realm Warp, stop Ryze himself with Lissandra W Ring of Frost or Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Ryze.phase: Ryze lacks mana and damage early, so Lissandra should look for opportunities to pressure him before he scales. In the late game, focus on stopping engages and crowd control over raw damage.

Fizz.watch: If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts. Fizz may go in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark erupts, so prepare Lissandra W Ring of Frost or Lissandra R Frozen Tomb at his entry path. Don't rush your root and ultimate while Fizz E Playful / Trickster is still ready.
Fizz.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Fizz's damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first and fit Banshee's Veil between core items to block the first spell in his combo. Since Fizz is an engage assassin, build Zhonya's Hourglass earlier too.
Fizz.combo: When Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path to close the gap and recast it to move to its location. Root him with W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then follow with Q Ice Shard and R Frozen Tomb, in that order. If you wait until after arriving to decide whether to press W Ring of Frost, Fizz will have a chance to escape.
Fizz.escape: The moment after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down opens a window to go in with Lissandra E Glacial Path. Fizz Q Urchin Strike is also a mobility spell, so don't assume he has no way out just because Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down. If Fizz's crowd control is ready, recast Lissandra E Glacial Path immediately so you don't get immobilized first and have your teleport interrupted.
Fizz.fight: Take your chance to counterattack right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, and save Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb for then. If Fizz misses a last hit with an empowered basic attack from Fizz W Seastone Trident, that's a chance to trade. Close the gap first only when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together.
Fizz.laning: Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping up in levels. If Fizz is behind minions, aim Lissandra Q Ice Shard at a minion first so it reaches Fizz behind it. Save Lissandra E Glacial Path; using it for poke first leaves you vulnerable to ganks.
Fizz.phase: In the early game, Lissandra should hold on and keep up in levels with Lissandra Q Ice Shard, then look for a chance when Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down. In the late game, focus on crowd control that stops Fizz's engage rather than dealing damage.
Fizz.teamfight: Stand close to an ally to bait out Fizz E Playful / Trickster, then attack together once it's down. If Fizz goes in, stop him with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb and root him with W Ring of Frost. If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts.

Akali.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Akali deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance and fit Banshee's Veil between core items. Lissandra's magic damage is easily mitigated by Akali's high magic resistance, so build penetration too.
Akali.combo: After Akali's escape tools are down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path to close the gap. Recast E Glacial Path and root her with W Ring of Frost as soon as you arrive, then use Q Ice Shard followed by R Frozen Tomb. If you wait until after arriving to decide whether to use W Ring of Frost, Akali may get a chance to escape.
Akali.escape: Don't engage just because Akali W Twilight Shroud is down; check Akali E Shuriken Flip and R Perfect Execution too. In particular, engage with Lissandra E Glacial Path while Akali cannot use R Perfect Execution again after using it and both W Twilight Shroud and E Shuriken Flip are down. Follow with W Ring of Frost and R Frozen Tomb to prevent Akali from escaping.
Akali.fight: Trade when Lissandra E Glacial Path and W Ring of Frost are both available, and use W Ring of Frost only when you've clearly closed the gap.
Akali.laning: Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping pace in levels. If Akali is behind minions, aim to hit a minion first so the shard reaches Akali behind it. Don't use E Glacial Path for poke, and save W Ring of Frost and R Frozen Tomb when roaming.
Akali.phase: In the late game, focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Akali.teamfight: Before the fight, decide whether to go in with Lissandra E Glacial Path and root multiple enemies with W Ring of Frost, or counter Akali's engage with R Frozen Tomb. If counter-engaging, interrupt Akali R Perfect Execution as she comes in with R Frozen Tomb cast on the enemy. When you need to survive Akali's finishing attack, cast R Frozen Tomb on yourself to use its damage immunity and healing.
Akali.watch: Once marked, the second dash follows Lissandra as she tries to escape.

Annie.build: Early on, use Null-Magic Mantle to withstand the damage and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Annie deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first and fit Banshee's Veil between core items to block one targeted ability before you engage.
Annie.combo: When Annie P Pyromania's stun is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path and recast it to approach, then root her with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive. Follow with Lissandra Q Ice Shard and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, in that order.
Annie.escape: The moment Annie P Pyromania's stun is used is your chance to engage with Lissandra E Glacial Path. Annie has no mobility spell, but Annie E Molten Shield can increase her movement speed, so root her with Lissandra W Ring of Frost as soon as you close in.
Annie.fight: After Annie P Pyromania's stun is down, trade when Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost are both available. Account for the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield and root her with Lissandra W Ring of Frost immediately after closing in with Lissandra E Glacial Path.
Annie.laning: Don't spend long trading ranged poke early; use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping pace in levels. If Annie stands behind minions, aim to hit a minion first so the shard reaches Annie behind it. Using Lissandra E Glacial Path for poke leaves you vulnerable to ganks, so save it.
Annie.phase: Early on, avoid poke trades and keep pace in levels because Lissandra has short range. In the late game, focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing pure damage.
Annie.teamfight: Don't group multiple allies together when Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready or Annie is out of vision. Decide in advance whether to stop Annie with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb if she steps forward to engage, or engage with Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost after her stun is down. Don't stay near Tibbers even after Annie is killed.
Annie.watch: When Annie P Pyromania glows white, her stun is ready, so don't enter Annie's ability range. Annie R Summon: Tibbers deals area damage, and the summoned Tibbers remains dangerous even after Annie dies, so keep your distance.

Ekko.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ekko's damage is mostly magic, and Lissandra has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Then fit Banshee's Veil between core items, and build Zhonya's Hourglass earlier if you need to withstand Ekko's engage.
Ekko.combo: While Ekko R Chronobreak is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path and recast it to close the gap. Root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then use Lissandra Q Ice Shard followed by Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on the enemy. If Ekko goes in first with Ekko E Phase Dive, you can immediately counter with Lissandra W Ring of Frost.
Ekko.escape: If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, he can still escape with Ekko R Chronobreak, so don't rush your engage. Look for a window after Ekko R Chronobreak is down and Ekko W Parallel Convergence has also been used. If Ekko's crowd control is ready, watch for its signal and choose your timing so you aren't immobilized before recasting Lissandra E Glacial Path.
Ekko.fight: In the early game, trade only when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together. Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, look for a chance to root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and follow with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. While Ekko R Chronobreak is down, close the gap and engage with Lissandra E Glacial Path.
Ekko.laning: Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping up in levels. If Ekko is behind minions, aim to hit a minion first with Lissandra Q Ice Shard so it reaches him behind them. Save Lissandra E Glacial Path; using it for poke first leaves you vulnerable to ganks.
Ekko.phase: In the early game, use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to keep up in levels and trade carefully. In the late game, focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage, and look for an opportunity when Ekko R Chronobreak is down.
Ekko.teamfight: If Ekko goes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, interrupt him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost or Lissandra R Frozen Tomb cast on the enemy. If you decide to engage first, go in with Lissandra E Glacial Path, root multiple enemies with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then follow with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If you need to survive Ekko's finisher, cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on yourself to avoid damage and heal.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave its area to avoid the stun and shield. Ekko Q Timewinder's returning hit deals more damage, so get out of its return path. If you see Ekko's afterimage behind him, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready; don't chase recklessly, even if he's low on health.

Irelia.build: Hold on with Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Irelia's damage is mostly physical, and Lissandra has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Build Zhonya's Hourglass earlier if the enemy team has an engage assassin.
Irelia.combo: While Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path and recast it to close the gap. Root her with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then use Lissandra Q Ice Shard followed by Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Irelia.escape: The moment after Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge as mobility is your chance to close the gap with Lissandra E Glacial Path. If Irelia E Flawless Duet's stun is ready, you could be immobilized before recasting Lissandra E Glacial Path and have your teleport interrupted, so choose carefully when to engage.
Irelia.fight: After that, fight only when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together. If Irelia goes in on Lissandra, stop her movement with the root from Lissandra W Ring of Frost or the stun from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Irelia.laning: Don't leave a minion at around half health between you and Irelia; step back when a minion is about to die. If Irelia is behind minions, aim to hit one first with Lissandra Q Ice Shard so it reaches Irelia behind it. Don't use Lissandra W Ring of Frost carelessly to clear the wave, and don't spend Lissandra E Glacial Path early for poke.
Irelia.phase: In the late game, focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Irelia.teamfight: In team fights, focus Irelia first and interrupt her with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb as she goes in. If you decide to engage first, go in with Lissandra E Glacial Path, root multiple enemies with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then follow with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. When you're in danger, Lissandra R Frozen Tomb cast on yourself can provide damage immunity and healing, but remember that you can't do anything while in stasis.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain from low-health minions to close in, so create distance when minions are about to die. Don't cast Lissandra E Glacial Path carelessly while Irelia E Flawless Duet's stun is ready. If trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Kassadin.phase: In the late game, watch for Kassadin R Riftwalk as both an engage and an escape, while Lissandra focuses on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Kassadin.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads early. Kassadin deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance, and fit Banshee's Veil between core items. If you need to withstand Kassadin's engage, build Zhonya's Hourglass earlier too.
Kassadin.combo: When Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward, then recast it to move to the claw's location. Almost as soon as you arrive, root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then use Lissandra Q Ice Shard and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb in that order.
Kassadin.escape: After Kassadin uses Kassadin R Riftwalk repeatedly, check his mana bar to judge whether he can move again, and counterattack when he runs out of mana. If the slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse is a problem, don't delay recasting Lissandra E Glacial Path.
Kassadin.fight: Trade when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together and Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield is down. Once Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, close the distance with Lissandra E Glacial Path and lock him down.
Kassadin.laning: Using unnecessary abilities near Kassadin reduces Kassadin E Force Pulse's cooldown, so clear waves from outside Kassadin's range whenever possible. Don't use Lissandra E Glacial Path for poke or waste Lissandra W Ring of Frost on waveclear.
Kassadin.teamfight: If you expect Kassadin to dive the back line, save Lissandra R Frozen Tomb to interrupt him with a stun as he engages. If you decide to engage first, lock him down with Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then follow with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. When in danger, cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on yourself to survive with damage immunity and healing, but account for being unable to act while stasis lasts.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield absorbs Lissandra Q Ice Shard's magic damage, so poke after the shield is down. Watch out for the slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse and Kassadin R Riftwalk, and don't stand alone within range of Kassadin R Riftwalk.

Leblanc.escape: Right after LeBlanc uses LeBlanc W Distortion is an opportunity to close the gap, but engaging after her return window ends or after she has already returned is more reliable. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains is still available, do not delay recasting Lissandra E Glacial Path; dodge the chains or engage once the risk of being rooted has passed.
Leblanc.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads early. LeBlanc deals mostly magic damage, and Lissandra has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize building magic resistance. Fit Banshee's Veil between core items, and build Zhonya's Hourglass earlier too against an assassin who engages onto you.
Leblanc.combo: After LeBlanc W Distortion's window to return disappears, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward, then recast it to move to the claw's location. Almost as soon as you arrive, root her with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then use Lissandra Q Ice Shard and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb in that order. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, recast Lissandra E Glacial Path before the root takes hold.
Leblanc.fight: Avoid extended poke trades early, and trade when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together. Close the distance with Lissandra E Glacial Path after LeBlanc W Distortion's window to return to her starting position expires or has already been used. Follow with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb to lock her down.
Leblanc.laning: Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping up in levels. If LeBlanc is behind minions, aim to hit a minion first so the shard reaches her behind it. Save Lissandra E Glacial Path instead of using it for poke, as doing so leaves you vulnerable to ganks, and alert your team immediately if LeBlanc disappears from vision.
Leblanc.phase: Early on, Lissandra is at a disadvantage in ranged poke trades because of her short range, so use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to keep up in levels and survive. In the late game, focus on stopping engages and providing crowd control rather than dealing raw damage.
Leblanc.teamfight: Decide in advance whether to counter LeBlanc's engage or go in first with Lissandra E Glacial Path. If you go in first, lock the target down with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then follow with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If you're counter-engaging, interrupt her as she dives in with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. When you're about to take the finishing damage yourself, cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on yourself to survive.
Leblanc.watch: If the mark from LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice is still active, the next ability deals more damage, so don't move forward; back away until the mark disappears. LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains roots you after the tether holds, so if it hits, immediately use Lissandra E Glacial Path to get out of range. If LeBlanc P Mirror Image creates a clone, check which one actually attacks before using your abilities.

Malzahar.escape: Malzahar has no mobility ability to create distance, so dodging Malzahar Q Call of the Void and removing Malzahar P Void Shift create an opportunity to engage. If Voidlings are already out, clear them first with an area ability, then close the gap with Lissandra E Glacial Path. If you use Lissandra E Glacial Path while Malzahar still has crowd control available, don't delay the recast.
Malzahar.phase: Early on, push the wave or pressure Malzahar with your jungler so he has no time to build scaling stacks. Malzahar gets stronger as the game goes on while the impact of Lissandra's raw damage declines, so focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control in the late game.
Malzahar.build: Early on, survive with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Malzahar's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Fit Banshee's Veil between core items to help you engage.
Malzahar.combo: First remove Malzahar P Void Shift with Lissandra Q Ice Shard. After dodging Malzahar Q Call of the Void, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward, then press Lissandra W Ring of Frost right after recasting to move. Follow up with Lissandra Q Ice Shard and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, remove it first with Lissandra Q Ice Shard before fighting. Trade when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together, and when you've just dodged Malzahar Q Call of the Void.
Malzahar.laning: Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping up in levels, and look for an angle to hit a minion first so it reaches Malzahar behind it. Move away from a minion afflicted with Malzahar E Malefic Visions when it is about to die. Call your jungler when Malzahar has pushed the lane, and engage together after removing Malzahar P Void Shift.
Malzahar.teamfight: Decide first whether to engage or counter-engage. If you go in, engage with Lissandra E Glacial Path when there are no Voidlings, root multiple enemies with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then follow with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If counter-engaging, use Lissandra R Frozen Tomb to stop the enemy's engage, and cast it on yourself in a dangerous moment to gain damage immunity and healing.
Malzahar.watch: When a minion afflicted with Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect spreads to a nearby enemy, so move away from that minion. If you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move outside the line between the two portals and delay engaging until the silence ends. Malzahar R Nether Grasp is dangerous because it suppresses and deals damage based on maximum health, so don't pass through areas without vision alone while his ultimate is available.

Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility, so right after you sidestep Mel E Solar Snare or she uses Mel W Rebuttal is an opportunity to engage. If you are immobilized after casting Lissandra E Glacial Path, its recast will fail, so do not rush to engage while Mel E Solar Snare is available.
Mel.phase: Early ranged poke trades favor Mel over Lissandra, but push the wave and pressure her so she has no time to build up. Mel's scaling accumulates in the late game, so Lissandra should focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control.
Mel.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads early. Mel deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize building magic resistance, and fit Banshee's Veil between core items.
Mel.combo: When Mel E Solar Snare is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward and recast it; as soon as you arrive, root her with Lissandra W Ring of Frost. Then hit her with Lissandra Q Ice Shard and use Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If Mel W Rebuttal is still available, watch out for the reflection when casting Lissandra Q Ice Shard.
Mel.fight: Instead of trading ranged poke, trade when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together.
Mel.laning: Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping up in levels. If Mel stands behind minions, aim to hit a minion first so the shard reaches her behind it. Don't use Lissandra E Glacial Path for poke, and after pushing the wave, look to roam if Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb are available.
Mel.teamfight: When engaging, go in with Lissandra E Glacial Path, root multiple enemies with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then follow with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If there's no opening to engage, save Lissandra R Frozen Tomb to stop the enemy's engage. If Mel's attacks have stacked up and you're at risk of being executed, cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on yourself to avoid the damage and heal.
Mel.watch: Mel E Solar Snare roots you if it hits its center, and Mel Q Radiant Volley may follow, so dodge to the side. Don't cast Lissandra Q Ice Shard carelessly while Mel W Rebuttal is available. If you've been hit by Mel's attacks several times, watch out for the execute from Mel P Searing Brilliance even if you still have health, and after the fight wait in a safe place until the stacks disappear.

Orianna.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Orianna’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots, and fit Banshee’s Veil between your core items.
Orianna.combo: Cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward, then recast it to blink to the ball’s location. Root Orianna with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then use Lissandra Q Ice Shard followed by Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Orianna.escape: Right after Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball away from her, check the ball’s position and the danger of Orianna R Command: Shockwave before engaging. Orianna has no ability to create distance on her own, so close in with Lissandra E Glacial Path and root her with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. Save Lissandra E Glacial Path instead of using it for poke, so you keep your escape available.
Orianna.fight: The moment after Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball away from her is an opportunity to trade. In the early game, contest with Lissandra Q Ice Shard instead of trading basic attacks, and engage when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together.
Orianna.laning: Don’t trade ranged poke for too long; secure last hits and clear the wave with Lissandra Q Ice Shard while keeping pace in levels. Against Orianna behind her minions, try hitting a minion first so the shard reaches her behind it. When roaming, push the wave first and move with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb ready.
Orianna.teamfight: Decide first whether to engage or counter the opponent’s engage. If engaging, check Orianna’s ball position, close in with Lissandra E Glacial Path, root multiple enemies with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then chain into Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If countering, save Lissandra R Frozen Tomb to stop the opponent’s engage.
Orianna.watch: Position yourself based on where Orianna’s ball moves with Orianna Q Command: Attack. Leave the area around the ball, where Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in. In the early game, also avoid extended basic-attack trades empowered by Orianna P Clockwork Windup.
Orianna.phase: Orianna has the edge in early ranged poke and extended auto-attack trades, so Lissandra should focus on keeping up in levels. In the late game, focus on stopping engages and crowd control over damage.

Sylas.build: Sylas deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Use Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. If you need more protection from magic damage, fit Banshee’s Veil between your core items.
Sylas.combo: While Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward, then recast it to blink to its location. Root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then chain Lissandra Q Ice Shard into Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Sylas.escape: Dodging the second chain of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct creates an opportunity to engage before the ability comes back. Sylas W Kingslayer is also a mobility tool, so if only one ability is down, check for the other. If you use Lissandra E Glacial Path while Sylas’s chains are available, move before crowd control can stop you and cancel the recast.
Sylas.fight: Trade when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together. After Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down, close the distance with Lissandra E Glacial Path and keep him from escaping with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If Sylas W Kingslayer is still available, check whether he has used it before engaging, since he can heal and escape with it.
Sylas.laning: Against Sylas behind his minions, try hitting a minion first so Lissandra Q Ice Shard reaches him behind it. Save Lissandra W Ring of Frost for an engage or jungle follow-up, and don’t use Lissandra E Glacial Path for simple poke.
Sylas.phase: In the late game, focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Sylas.teamfight: When Sylas goes in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, lock him down with Lissandra W Ring of Frost or Lissandra R Frozen Tomb and kill him before Sylas W Kingslayer can heal him. When engaging first, look for an angle to root multiple enemies with Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then chain into Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. Watch your distance so Sylas can’t get in range to steal Lissandra’s ultimate.
Sylas.watch: With Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, watch out for the chains that follow the first dash. If they hit, you’ll be knocked up and take a follow-up combo, so use Lissandra E Glacial Path to dodge the chains, and immediately leave the intersection point of Sylas Q Chain Lash. Sylas W Kingslayer heals more at low health, so don’t delay finishing him off.

Talon.build: Use Cloth Armor early to withstand Talon’s physical damage, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Since Talon is an engage assassin, rush Zhonya’s Hourglass for both ability power and armor. Talon’s high magic resistance can easily blunt Lissandra’s magic damage, so include penetration in your build.
Talon.combo: While Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward, then recast it to blink to its location. Root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then chain Lissandra Q Ice Shard into Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If you wait to cast Lissandra W Ring of Frost until after blinking, Talon will have a chance to escape.
Talon.escape: The moment after you make Talon use Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is a window to engage with Lissandra E Glacial Path. It’s even better to counterattack if you’ve confirmed Talon has also used Talon R Shadow Assault. Engage while Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb are available to prevent Talon from escaping.
Talon.fight: Avoid direct trades with Talon early, and trade only when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together. Right after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, close the distance with Lissandra E Glacial Path and root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost.
Talon.laning: Secure last hits and clear the wave with Lissandra Q Ice Shard, and also look for an angle to hit a minion first so the shard reaches Talon behind it. Save Lissandra E Glacial Path so you aren’t vulnerable to a jungle gank after using it for poke; keep vision along Talon’s roaming routes and share his position with your team.
Talon.teamfight: If Talon is likely to enter your backline, fight grouped with your team and root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb as soon as he engages. If you decide to engage first, go in with Lissandra E Glacial Path, root multiple enemies with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then chain into Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. When you need to withstand Talon’s finishing damage, cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on yourself to use its damage immunity and healing.
Talon.watch: If you’re hit by the first strike of Talon W Rake, prioritize getting out of the returning blades’ path. Being hit by the returning blades can stack Talon P Blade's End and cause a bleed. While Talon R Shadow Assault is available, he can use stealth and increased movement speed to escape, so don’t chase recklessly.
Talon.phase: In the late game, focus on stopping engages and crowd control over Lissandra’s raw damage, and work with your team to counter Talon as his impact falls off.

Veigar.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Veigar's magic damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first, then fit Banshee's Veil between core items to block one targeted ability before you engage.
Veigar.combo: After Veigar E Event Horizon is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path to advance, then recast it to move to the claw. Root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then use Lissandra Q Ice Shard followed by Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Veigar.escape: Veigar has no mobility, so when Veigar E Event Horizon is down, you have a chance to engage with Lissandra E Glacial Path. If Veigar E Event Horizon is ready, don't use Lissandra E Glacial Path to poke first; save it to escape if you get trapped.
Veigar.fight: Trade when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together. When Veigar E Event Horizon is down, close the gap with Lissandra E Glacial Path and root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. Keep moving during the fight to dodge Veigar W Dark Matter.
Veigar.laning: Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping up in levels, and stand behind minions to dodge Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Don't waste Lissandra W Ring of Frost on wave clear; save it for an engage or to follow up on a gank.
Veigar.phase: In the late game, Veigar grows stronger from Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power stacks, so track his position and whether Veigar E Event Horizon is available, and focus on crowd control.
Veigar.teamfight: Decide first whether to engage or counter the enemy's engage. If you engage, check whether Veigar E Event Horizon has been used, then root him with Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost before following up with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If you counter-engage, save Lissandra R Frozen Tomb to stop their engage; when in danger, cast it on yourself to avoid damage and heal.
Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge. If you are trapped inside, don't run into the edge; move around inside and wait for it to disappear, or use Lissandra E Glacial Path to escape. Veigar W Dark Matter shows where and when it will land, so keep moving to dodge it. If you are below half health, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on your missing health.

Vex.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vex deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first and fit Banshee's Veil between core items.
Vex.combo: Once the Doom effect from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path and recast it to close in. Root her with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then use Lissandra Q Ice Shard followed by Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Vex.escape: Look for an engage when the Doom effect from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom has been used on the wave or to poke and Vex W Personal Space is also down.
Vex.fight: Trade after both Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's Doom and Vex W Personal Space are down. When you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together, close in and root her, then follow up with Lissandra Q Ice Shard.
Vex.laning: Don't extend early ranged poke trades. Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping up in levels. If Vex stands behind minions, hit a minion with Lissandra Q Ice Shard first and aim for the shard to reach her behind it. Save Lissandra E Glacial Path; using it to poke first leaves you vulnerable to a gank.
Vex.phase: Lissandra is weak in early ranged poke trades, so use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to survive and keep up in levels. In the late game, focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing raw damage.
Vex.teamfight: If an ally marked by Vex R Shadow Surge is about to die, Vex's ultimate will come back up, so move low-health allies out of her range first. If Vex dashes in, stop her with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb and take her down with your allies. If you choose to engage first, wait until Vex's Doom is down, then root her with Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost before following up with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Vex.watch: When Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's Doom indicator is active, she can interrupt an engage with a basic ability and fear you, so delay your Lissandra E Glacial Path engage. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits you and applies its mark, move toward your allies to set up a counterattack on her follow-up dash.

Viktor.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Viktor deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance and fit Banshee's Veil between core items. When escaping Viktor W Gravity Field, movement speed helps sooner than tenacity.
Viktor.combo: Cast Lissandra E Glacial Path in the direction you want to advance, then recast it to move to the claw.
