Root Viktor with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then use Lissandra Q Ice Shard followed by Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. Don't continue the combo inside Viktor W Gravity Field; leave it first.
Viktor.escape: Viktor has no dash to escape on his own, so close the gap with Lissandra E Glacial Path when Viktor W Gravity Field is down. If you engage while Viktor W Gravity Field is ready, recast Lissandra E Glacial Path before you are immobilized.
Viktor.fight: Instead of trading back against ranged poke, trade when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together. Approach after Viktor W Gravity Field is down or after you leave its area. Viktor has no dash to escape on his own, so once you are on him, root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Viktor.laning: Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping up in levels. If Viktor stands behind minions, hit a minion with Lissandra Q Ice Shard first and aim for an angle that reaches him behind it. Don't use Lissandra E Glacial Path to poke first. After pushing the wave, roam while Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb are ready.
Viktor.phase: Pressure Viktor early, before Viktor P Glorious Evolution stacks up. Viktor's growth builds over time, so focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage in the late game.
Viktor.teamfight: Watch the position of Viktor W Gravity Field. If you can get to Viktor, approach with Lissandra E Glacial Path and follow with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If it's difficult to engage, save Lissandra R Frozen Tomb to stop the enemy's engage. When you are low and need to survive the enemy's finishing damage, cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on yourself.
Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so don't stand in line with the wave; sidestep it. Viktor W Gravity Field stuns you if you stay inside, so leave as soon as it appears and don't continue trading in it. Viktor R Arcane Storm also deals area damage, so don't stay in its area for long.

Xerath.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Xerath deals mostly magic damage, and Lissandra has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Fit Banshee's Veil between core items.
Xerath.combo: After Xerath's crowd control is down, cast Lissandra E Glacial Path and recast it to teleport to the claw. Root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, then use Lissandra Q Ice Shard followed by Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the moment after Xerath W Eye of Destruction and Xerath E Shocking Orb are down is your window to engage. If you cast Lissandra E Glacial Path while Xerath E Shocking Orb is ready, recast it immediately so you don't get immobilized before the recast and lose the teleport.
Xerath.fight: Xerath has the advantage in a range contest, so only trade when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together.
Xerath.laning: Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping up in levels. Rather than trying to dodge all of Xerath's poke, avoid the heavy damage while farming. When Xerath is running low on mana, push the lane and call your jungler. Avoid using Lissandra E Glacial Path to poke first and leaving yourself vulnerable to a gank.
Xerath.teamfight: Decide in advance whether to engage first or counter the enemy's engage. If you engage, root multiple enemies with Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then follow up with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If you counter-engage, save Lissandra R Frozen Tomb to stop their engage; when you urgently need to survive, cast it on yourself to avoid damage and heal.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so when you see him charging it, change direction and sidestep. If Xerath E Shocking Orb stuns you, he can follow up with more attacks, so be especially careful when engaging. When Xerath R Rite of the Arcane begins, dodge immediately or engage Xerath while he cannot move.
Xerath.phase: Xerath has the edge in early ranged poke thanks to his longer range, so Lissandra should farm and keep up in levels. In the late game, focus on stopping engages and crowd control over damage.

Yasuo.build: Yasuo deals primarily physical damage, and Lissandra has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to hold on in the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If the enemy team has an engage assassin, prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass for its ability power and armor.
Yasuo.combo: Remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield first, then engage after he throws Yasuo Q Steel Tempest's tornado. Cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward and recast it to travel, then root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost almost as soon as you arrive, followed by Lissandra Q Ice Shard and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is in front of you, go around it or wait for it to disappear before using Lissandra Q Ice Shard.
Yasuo.escape: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don't engage just because he used it once. Right after he throws Yasuo Q Steel Tempest's tornado and before Yasuo R Last Breath is back up, close the gap with Lissandra E Glacial Path and root him with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If you are immobilized before recasting Lissandra E Glacial Path, the teleport is canceled, so don't delay the recast out of concern for Yasuo Q Steel Tempest's knock-up.
Yasuo.fight: First remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield with light poke, then commit to a full trade. Right after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest's tornado is thrown, he has no way to knock you up for a while, so look to engage if Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost are ready. Lissandra W Ring of Frost has short range and a long cooldown at low levels, so use it only once you have definitely closed the gap.
Yasuo.laning: Use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping pace in levels. Keeping the wave thin on your side, with fewer minions for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to dash through, makes it easier to stop him from closing in. If you use Lissandra E Glacial Path to poke, you'll be vulnerable to ganks, so when roaming, check that Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb are ready.
Yasuo.phase: In the early game, hold on and keep pace in levels, accounting for Lissandra's short range and Lissandra W Ring of Frost's long cooldown. In the late game, focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control rather than dealing raw damage.
Yasuo.teamfight: Decide before the team fight whether to engage first or counter Yasuo's engage. If you engage first, approach with Lissandra E Glacial Path, root multiple enemies with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then follow with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If you counter-engage, interrupt Yasuo as he goes in with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. When you are about to take lethal damage, cast it on yourself to use its damage immunity and healing.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so sidestep instead of only backing away when he approaches. The tornado after two hits knocks you up, so watch the stack sound and effect and dodge early. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade lets him dash through minions to close in, and Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks projectiles, so save Lissandra Q Ice Shard while the wall is in front of you.

Karma.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads early. Karma's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Fit Banshee's Veil between core items to block one targeted ability before you engage.
Karma.combo: Cast Lissandra E Glacial Path forward, then recast it to move to the claw's location. Almost as soon as you arrive, root the target with Lissandra W Ring of Frost, then use Lissandra Q Ice Shard and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb in that order. If Karma W Focused Resolve is available, don't delay recasting Lissandra E Glacial Path.
Karma.escape: After Karma W Focused Resolve is used, look for a chance to close the distance with Lissandra E Glacial Path. Once Karma E Inspire's movement speed boost and shield have expired, follow with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects first, create distance to avoid the root rather than forcing an engage.
Karma.fight: Instead of trading into her early ranged poke, trade when you can use Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost together. Engage after baiting out Karma W Focused Resolve and Karma E Inspire's shield has expired. Once you close the distance, lock her down with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb.
Karma.laning: Lissandra is at a disadvantage in early ranged poke trades because of her short range, so use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to last-hit and clear waves while keeping up in levels. If Karma stands behind minions, aim to hit a minion first so the shard reaches Karma behind it. Don't use Lissandra E Glacial Path for poke, and keep Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb available when you push the wave and roam.
Karma.phase: Lissandra is at a disadvantage against Karma's early ranged poke, so use Lissandra Q Ice Shard to keep up in levels. In the late game, focus on stopping engages and providing crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Karma.teamfight: When starting a fight, first bait out Karma W Focused Resolve, then engage after the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E expires. If you enter with Lissandra E Glacial Path, root multiple enemies with Lissandra W Ring of Frost as soon as you arrive, then follow with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If there's no opening to engage, save Lissandra R Frozen Tomb to stop the enemy's engage.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame pokes with a slow and area damage, and taking hits from her abilities also reduces Karma R Mantra's cooldown. If hit by the empowered Karma R Mantra Q's field, walk out of its radius before it detonates. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance to break it before the root takes hold.

Lux.build: Early on, withstand Lux's magic damage with a Null-Magic Mantle. Choose Mercury's Treads and fit Banshee's Veil between core items. Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so Lissandra's magic damage also deals well against her.
